title: First CIA director on the NICAP board
summary: Dylan Borland tells of First CIA director on the NICAP board, about 1950s-1960s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He was the first CIA director, Navy Admiral and he was on the board of directors for New Fork.

plain: A researcher named Dylan Borland, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about NICAP, a private civilian group that investigated UFO reports in the 1950s and 60s. Borland says that Roscoe Hillenkoetter, a Navy admiral who was the first director of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, sat on NICAP's board of directors. He tells it because, if true, it would mean a top intelligence figure took UFOs seriously.
